endpoints.summary: Negotiate the control protocol major before product calls.
List installed harnesses and their availability.

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: Request a fresh readiness/status projection instead of only cached truth.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Include fake/test harness adapters in the listing.

parameters.name: harness
parameters.description: Scope the status calculation to the given harness ids (repeat to select several).

endpoints.summary: Re-check a harness's auth readiness (dry).
List a harness's selectable models.

endpoints.summary: Run retention GC over expired run trees and expired trash threads.
Inspect installed vendor CLIs: selected program and version, managed copy, tested pin and maintainability; never logs in or installs.

parameters.name: harness
parameters.description: Restrict to these installable harness ids (repeat to select several).

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: Re-inspect instead of returning the cached installation facts.

parameters.name: checkLatest
parameters.description: Also read the newest published version where the mechanism supports it; omitted keeps the last observation (null = not checked).

endpoints.summary: Accept one durable update/return of an installed vendor CLI; the 202 handle is not success.
Read one maintenance operation's lifecycle and before/target/after evidence.
Cancel a maintenance operation; the installer's process tree is stopped and its effect disclosed.
Accept one idempotent model generation without an agent run.

parameters.name: captureEffortEvidence
parameters.description: Retain typed effort preparation and observation evidence in the private result. Omitted or false preserves the legacy result shape; the choice is bound to idempotency.

parameters.name: captureFailureEvidence
parameters.description: Retain exact failed-response bytes and exception details in the private result. Omitted or false preserves the legacy result shape.

endpoints.summary: Inspect dispatch, outcome and response custody for the same operation.
Acknowledge the exact result digest and release temporary model bytes.
Cancel an existing model operation; settled results remain settled.
Read exact model response bytes without acknowledging delivery.
List raw model transports, independent of agent harnesses.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Opt in to account catalog and processing transport capabilities; omitted preserves the legacy source shape.

endpoints.summary: Read a selected account's raw model catalog and context evidence.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Enumerate every enabled account's separate inventory and availability; omitted selects one account using the inference pool criteria. Account view cannot be combined with requestedModel.

parameters.name: credentialProfileId
parameters.description: Pin a managed profile; omitted selects the engine's Auto account.

parameters.name: includeAdmission
parameters.description: With requestedModel, include exact-model account admission and the source inventory-absence policy, plus declared client version. Omitted or false preserves the legacy shape; cannot combine with account view. Admission is not generation proof.

parameters.name: requestedModel
parameters.description: Select one account through this model's authentication, quota and source inventory policy; omitted discovers without a model constraint.

endpoints.summary: List the implemented operations (this catalog).

Register a project root as a durable handle.

endpoints.summary: Fetch one bounded raster image contained by a registered project; served only by the remote runtime (a local daemon answers 501).

parameters.description: Relative path contained by the registered project; the content must be a raster image (magic-byte validated).

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: Run of this project whose recorded caller-owned execution workspace the path is relative to; a missing workspace answers 410 execution_workspace_unavailable, never the project's file.

Fetch one durable output file from a project.
Relink a registered project to a new root.

endpoints.summary: Inspect a journal partition for recovery.
Export a journal partition (dry).

parameters.description: Absolute existing project root whose protected-path policy and Git prerequisite should be projected.

endpoints.summary: List a bounded, newest-first, keyset-paginated page of durable run summaries visible to the daemon.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum run summaries to return (1..1000; default 200). The page is newest-first by (createdAt, id).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Return only runs in this lifecycle state.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a prior page's nextCursor; returns the next (older) page. A malformed cursor is a typed 400.

endpoints.summary: Start a run and return its durable handle.
Read a run's full detail snapshot.
Apply a run's work product to the live tree; replay of an already-delivered run is a typed idempotent no-op.
Dry-check whether a run's patch would apply; an already-delivered run reports the safe already-applied no-op.
List a run tree's technical artifacts.
Fetch one artifact file from a run tree.
Cancel a queued or running run.
Record an operator unblock/rerun decision on a run.
Replay + tail a run's event stream (SSE).

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume cursor sent on reconnect: the run's nonnegative integer event `seq` (a canonical decimal; malformed/negative/fractional values are refused). Omit to snapshot-then-subscribe from the beginning.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description: Compatibility alias for the Last-Event-ID header (same numeric run `seq`); the header wins when both are present.

endpoints.summary: Answer a run's pending interactive question.

Place a live message into a run's active attempt and return a typed receipt: delivered (native consumption observed), accepted (native acceptance observed, consumption unproved), rejected, not_active, unsupported, or delivery_unknown. Every typed outcome answers HTTP 200 (unlike the answer and control routes); the Idempotency-Key is the message id and a replay returns the stored receipt.

Fetch one produced project-output file from a run.
